title: Ph.D. in Machine Learning
about: Georgia Tech's interdisciplinary Ph.D. in Machine Learning admits students through nine home schools. The program listing gives a Fall 2027 deadline of 15 December 2026 (11:59 PM Eastern); some home schools close earlier, from 1 December.
requirements: Admission is through one of nine home schools; deadlines vary by home school, the earliest being December 1
Most home schools have a final deadline of December 15

upskill.name: Machine Learning - Foundations & Methods I
why: field "Machine learning" → objective "Supervised learning: classification, regression, decision trees, SVMs, ensemble methods"
field "Machine learning" → objective "Unsupervised learning: clustering (k-means, DBSCAN), dimensionality reduction (PCA, t-SNE, UMAP)"
program "Ph.D. in Machine Learning" (doctoral research) → objective "Semi-supervised and self-supervised learning: leveraging unlabelled data at scale"
